transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

I guess… it’s gotten kind of out of hand with wasps. I plan my whole summer around avoiding them. I’ve stopped helping with the garden jobs at church, and if I hear buzzing near the back porch, I make my husband unload things instead.
Do you do any repeated checking or rituals to feel safe from wasps?
I don’t think so. I mean… I avoid places and I’ll look around if I’m outside, but I wouldn’t call it a ritual.
Outside of wasps, do you spend a lot of time worrying about many other everyday things?
Not really, no. I mean, I worry about normal things, I guess, but it doesn’t take over like the wasps do.
